newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Uraco managing director sells 15 mln share.
newsitem.headline: Uraco managing director sells 15 mln share.

text.p: Managing director of precision enginering group Uraco Holdings Ltd, Lim Ee Ann, said on Thursday he had sold 15 million shares recently for a "personal investment".
Lim did not give further details of the investment.

On Wednesday, Lim sold a total of 10 million shares of Uraco -- five million shares at Singapore $0.88 a share and another five million at US$0.90 each. Last Friday, he sold another five million at S$0.88.
After the sales, Lim's stake in the company has been reduced to 17 percent from 22.5 percent.
Early Thursday, Uraco was among the actively traded stocks with over 1.4 million shares changing hands. Lim told Reuters that he was not involved in the sales this morning.
Chairman Ng Kok Heng had told the Straits Times that Lim's sale would not have any material impact on the management of the company and that he had no intentions of selling his stake.
At 0217 GMT, Uraco shares lost $0.005 at S$0.895.
